extracted_constraints.clause: Project: Smart Grid Energy Management Platform for Municipal Utility
The system is a distributed energy management platform for a municipal utility serving 200,000 households
It integrates smart meters, renewable energy sources (solar panels, wind turbines), battery storage systems, and dema...
The system operates as a cyber-physical system with real-time monitoring and automated load balancing
[Core Functional Requirements]
Real-Time Monitoring: The system shall collect meter readings from 200,000+ smart meters at 15-minute intervals and p...
Demand Response: The system shall automatically adjust load distribution based on real-time demand, renewable generat...
Peak shaving algorithms must reduce peak demand by at least 15%
Renewable Integration: The system shall forecast solar and wind generation using weather data and historical patterns...
Billing & Analytics: The system shall support time-of-use pricing, net metering for prosumers, and provide consumptio...
[Non-Functional Constraints]
Real-Time Performance: Grid stability decisions must be computed within 500ms
Meter data ingestion must sustain 50,000 messages/second during peak collection windows
Reliability: The control system must maintain operation during partial network failures
Failover to backup control centers must complete within 30 seconds
Data loss of meter readings must not exceed 0
Safety: Automated load shedding must include safety interlocks to prevent equipment damage and ensure critical facili...
Sustainability: The system must optimize for carbon footprint reduction
Reporting must include ISO 14001 environmental metrics
The platform itself must minimize computational energy consumption
Security: The SCADA/ICS communication channels must be protected against cyber attacks per NERC CIP standards
All remote access must use multi-factor authentication
Scalability: The platform must scale to support up to 500,000 endpoints without architecture changes
